data.body: Gerrit push blocker after leaf completion. `rtk git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main` for commit ea394c34d13745cc0a14cea968b32f435ef15711 failed before upload because Git could not read a password for https://RebarBotNava@rebar.solutions.navateam.com. The configured osxkeychain helper returned no password using both the documented host-only lookup and username/path lookup. The supported batch SSH probe for RebarBotNava on port 29418 returned Permission denied (publickey), and no Gerrit password environment variable is present. No credential state was changed and no remote change was created. Local branch comment-remediation-3e32 is clean and ahead of origin/main by the one verified commit. Resume by provisioning the bot's Gerrit HTTP password in the configured credential helper, or by explicitly authorizing generation of a replacement credential in a signed-in Gerrit browser session, then retry the push. Do not amend or recreate the commit.
